{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only — this resolves the finding
completed_only = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check: now only completed orders
print('After filtering, shape:', completed_only.shape)

# Now check the conversion rate by channel
# But first: verify revenue is string with commas — parse it
print('Sample revenue before parsing:', completed_only['revenue'].head())

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_only['revenue_numeric'] = completed_only['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check: now numeric
print('Sample revenue after parsing:', completed_only['revenue_numeric'].head())

# Also check for QA orders — even though we filtered status, confirm no QA orders in completed
print('QA order count in completed:', (completed_only['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
